note: Mobile Detect wraps mobiledetect/mobiledetectlib as the 'mobile_detect' service, plus Twig functions (is_mobile/is_tablet/is_ios/is_android_os/is_device), three cache contexts, is-mobile/is-tablet body classes, two block-visibility Condition plugins (mobile_detect_device_type devices=[phone,tablet,desktop]; mobile_detect_platform platform=[android,ios]), a status block (mobile_detect_status_block), and a settings form (config mobile_detect.settings key mobile_detect_is_mobile bool). No external services. Medium/hard cases are grounded in live config verifiable via drush php:eval. NOTE: the boolean key must be set through the config API (getEditable()->set(..., TRUE/FALSE)); `drush config:set ... false` mis-casts and stores TRUE, so the scripts use php:eval.

evals.prompt: Using the mobile_detect module, which Twig functions can I call inside a template to branch on the visitor's device? List them.
evals.expected_output: The module's Twig extension provides is_mobile(), is_tablet(), is_device('Name'), is_ios() and is_android_os().

evals.prompt: In the mobile_detect module, what service can I call from PHP to detect the device, and what underlying library does it wrap?
evals.expected_output: Call \Drupal::service('mobile_detect'), which is the Detection\MobileDetect object from the mobiledetect/mobiledetectlib library (e.g. ->isMobile(), ->isTablet()).

evals.prompt: I want to show a block only on phones (or only on iOS) with the mobile_detect module. Which block-visibility condition plugins does it provide?
evals.expected_output: It provides two Condition plugins usable in a block's Visibility settings: mobile_detect_device_type (options phone/tablet/desktop) and mobile_detect_platform (options android/ios).

evals.prompt: On this site, inspect the mobile_detect module's configuration and tell me whether the experimental global 'is mobile' page cache context (mobile_detect_is_mobile) is currently turned on or off.
evals.expected_output: It is ON: config object mobile_detect.settings has mobile_detect_is_mobile = true.

evals.prompt: A 'Mobile Detect Status' block has been placed on this site with a device-platform visibility restriction. Inspect the live block configuration and tell me which platform the block is limited to.
evals.expected_output: The block (id mdeval_known, plugin mobile_detect_status_block) has a mobile_detect_platform visibility condition restricting it to the ios platform.

evals.prompt: Turn on the mobile_detect module's experimental global page cache context by setting mobile_detect_is_mobile to TRUE in its configuration, and apply it to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Set boolean TRUE for mobile_detect_is_mobile in config mobile_detect.settings, e.g. \Drupal::configFactory()->getEditable('mobile_detect.settings')->set('mobile_detect_is_mobile', TRUE)->save(); (note: `drush config:set ... true` mis-casts a boolean, so use the config API or the settings form).

evals.prompt: Place the mobile_detect module's 'Mobile Detect Status' block (plugin mobile_detect_status_block) in a region of the default theme, and restrict its visibility so it only shows on phones (device type = phone). Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Create a block config entity with plugin mobile_detect_status_block in the default theme, with visibility condition mobile_detect_device_type devices including 'phone' (e.g. Block::create([... 'plugin' => 'mobile_detect_status_block', 'visibility' => ['mobile_detect_device_type' => ['id' => 'mobile_detect_device_type', 'devices' => ['phone' => 'phone'], 'negate' => false]]])->save()).
